pr165445.title: Crash with C++20 modules and header units in clang 21
pr165445.bug_report_summary: Clang crashes while precompiling a C++20 module that consumes a header unit. The public fix explains that enum-constant visibility lookup in ASTWriter assumes a named owning module, but header units make getTopLevelOwningNamedModule return null, so module serialization crashes in GenerateNameLookupTable.

pr168912.title: AArch64 SVE small-vector extending-load assertion
pr168912.bug_report_summary: llc crashes for a reduced AArch64 SVE LLVM IR reproducer while lowering a small-vector multiply. The target signal is Unexpected vector MULL size in skipExtensionForVectorMULL/AArch64ISelLowering. The completed Git baseline identifies an AArch64 extending-load optimization as the first bad commit, so AArch64 SIMD/SVE lowering and extending-load combines are the primary risk areas.

pr205971.title: Clang member-template specialization frontend crash
pr205971.bug_report_summary: Clang crashes for invalid nested member-template specialization declarations. The target signal is Only member templates can be member template specializations in setMemberSpecialization/DeclTemplate.h. The Git baseline identifies the member-specialization implementation change as first bad, so template specialization lookup, Sema template declaration handling, and AST template metadata are the primary risk areas.
keywords: Only member templates can be member template specializations

pr206007.title: LoopVectorize loop-verifier assertion in opt
pr206007.bug_report_summary: opt crashes after loop-vectorization while verifying loop structure for a reduced LLVM IR testcase. The target signal is Loop block has no in-loop successors in verifyLoop/GenericLoopInfoImpl. The Git baseline identifies a ScalarEvolution ControlsOnlyExit change, so loop analysis, loop canonicalization, ScalarEvolution, and LoopVectorize are the primary risk areas.
keywords: Loop block has no in-loop successors

pr165246.title: Clang parser crash for invalid decltype declaration
pr165246.bug_report_summary: Clang crashes while parsing the invalid declaration int decltype {}. The target signal is AnnotatePreviousCachedTokens in PPCaching.cpp. The Git baseline identifies a parser crash fix as the first bad commit, so parser token caching, declaration parsing, diagnostics, and recovery paths are the primary risk areas.

pr167514.title: Clang C++20 CTAD alias-guide template crash
pr167514.bug_report_summary: Clang crashes for a C++20 concepts and CTAD alias-guide testcase. The target signal is getTemplateArgumentPackPatternForRewrite with unexpected pack arguments during template instantiation. The Git baseline identifies substituted-argument ordering for CTAD alias guides as first bad, so Sema template argument deduction, concepts, CTAD, and alias-template rewriting are the primary risk areas.

pr200648.title: Clang CodeGen crash for nested generic lambda
pr200648.bug_report_summary: Clang crashes while emitting a nested generic lambda in a trailing decltype expression. The target signal is VarDecl::evaluateValueImpl and !Init->isValueDependent in ConstantEmitter/CodeGenModule. The Git baseline identifies non-dependent lambda marking as first bad, so dependent-expression classification, generic lambdas, constant evaluation, and CodeGen value emission are the primary risk areas.

pr204561.title: Clang member-specialization template assertion
pr204561.bug_report_summary: Clang crashes for a malformed member-template specialization testcase. The target signal is hasAcceptableMemberSpecialization and not a member specialization in SemaLookup.cpp. The Git baseline identifies the member-specialization implementation change as first bad, so Sema template lookup, specialization acceptability checks, and AST template metadata are the primary risk areas.

pr165039.title: Clang consteval std::array placeholder crash
pr165039.bug_report_summary: Clang crashes or fails during C++20 consteval evaluation of a std::array non-type template argument used to build a tuple. The target signal includes cannot compile this l-value expression yet, Unexpected placeholder builtin type, CodeGenTypes, constant evaluation, and template argument handling, so commits touching constant evaluation, C++20 NTTP support, placeholder/builtin type lowering, Sema template handling, or CodeGen type conversion are high risk.
keywords: cannot compile this l-value expression yet

pr50655.title: ARM cmpxchg pseudo expansion assertion
pr50655.bug_report_summary: Clang crashes for a Thumbv7 compare-and-swap builtin during ARM pseudo-instruction expansion. The target signal includes ARMExpandPseudo::ExpandCMP_SWAP, DesiredReg used for UXT op must be tGPR, tGPRRegClass.contains, and Thumb code generation, so commits touching ARM atomic expansion, pseudo expansion, register-class constraints, Thumb lowering, or related CodeGen tests are high risk.
keywords: DesiredReg used for UXT op must be tGPR

pr54556.title: GNU ObjC frontend crash in clang 14 building Objective-C++ code
pr54556.bug_report_summary: Clang 14 regressed on Objective-C++ with the GNU runtime: compiling an instance-method call that passes a non-trivial C++ value such as std::string crashes during IR generation, with the stack rooted at clang::CodeGen::CreateGNUObjCRuntime and EmitObjCMessageExpr.

pr176682.title: Miscompilation at -O3 with profiled data using PGO
pr176682.bug_report_summary: Reduced LLVM miscompilation: plain -O3 on x86_64 prints 1, but -O3 with PGO using llvm-profdata prints 0. The local bisect and later analysis point to SelectionDAG legalization behavior around widened build_vector lanes.

pr187875.title: Miscompilation at -Os
pr187875.bug_report_summary: Reduced LLVM miscompilation: the program prints 55 without size optimization, but prints 53 at -Os. The existing local analysis shows the trigger commit was in loop vectorization and the visible semantic failure flowed through extract.last.active and SelectionDAG lowering.

pr191581.title: Miscompilation at -Os with profiled data using PGO
pr191581.bug_report_summary: Reduced LLVM miscompilation: plain -Os prints 9, but -Os with PGO using llvm-profdata prints 1. The local bisect ended in a LICM-related change, so loop transforms, hoisting, aliasing, and profile-sensitive optimizations are relevant risk areas.

pr172195.title: Clang crashes on valid code when compiling with profiled data using PGO
pr172195.bug_report_summary: LLVM frontend crash on valid C code with PGO: -O3 with profile data compiles, but -Os with -fprofile-instr-use crashes in loop-vectorize, with the stack trace pointing at LoopVectorizationCostModel::expectedCost on func_21. The known first bad commit from the email bisect is a VPlan change.

pr170421.title: Crash with PCH and -ftime-trace
pr170421.bug_report_summary: Clang crashes when compiling a source file with -ftime-trace while including a precompiled header. The issue report provides both the documented first bad commit 97fdc23 and the later fix commit 4e859c5a95ec; the LM-bisect profile normalizes that into the searchable interval regression^..fix^ so the first bad commit remains the documented regression inside the window.

pr193932.title: Crash in clang codegen with -gtemplate-alias
pr193932.good_ref: llvmorg-20.1.0 (issue says Clang 20.0.0 works; 20.1.0 used as local good anchor)
pr193932.bug_report_summary: Clang crashes in debug info code generation for a template-alias reproducer compiled with -O2 -gtemplate-alias. The issue text states the crash has been present since commit 366f48890d64 and that Clang 20.0.0 works, so the current LM-bisect setup uses a local Clang 20 tag as the good anchor and the documented regression commit itself as the bad anchor.

pr195788.title: Crash in clangd on pseudo-destructor selection
pr195788.bug_report_summary: clangd crashes during an LSP codeAction reproducer involving pseudo-destructor selection. The usable benchmark interval is the validated older good anchor llvmorg-15.0.7 to the validated bad parent of PR #195939.

pr196450.title: Crash in constexpr designated initialization
pr196450.bug_report_summary: Clang hits a frontend assertion while constexpr-evaluating a designated initializer with placement new under -std=c++2c. The current profile now uses the validated forward interval from llvmorg-19.1.7 to llvmorg-22.1.0 for real bisect runs.

pr196244.title: Crash in clangd token collection
pr196244.bug_report_summary: clangd crashes during an LSP documentSymbol reproducer on a deeply nested lambda testcase. The profile intentionally uses a long benchmark interval from llvmorg-8.0.1, which is good, to llvmorg-22.1.0, which is bad, even though the narrow validated release boundary is llvmorg-8.0.1 to llvmorg-9.0.1.

pr65982.title: Crash in C++20 virtual base name lookup
pr65982.bug_report_summary: Clang hits a frontend assertion while compiling a C++20 reproducer with virtual bases and pack-expanded using-declarations. The current profile now uses the validated forward interval from llvmorg-17.0.6 to the reporter crash build for real bisect runs.

pr190445.title: APInt ZeroExtend assertion while evaluating alloc_size
pr190445.bug_report_summary: Clang crashes with an APInt ZeroExtend assertion while compiling a reduced C++ reproducer with debug info and assembly output. The stack points through APInt::zext into CallExpr::evaluateBytesReturnedByAllocSizeCall and Sema::ActOnCastExpr, so alloc_size evaluation, APInt width handling, cast expressions, and Sema are the primary risk areas.

pr202343.title: Crash in ScalarEvolution ExitLimit at -O3
pr202343.bug_report_summary: Clang crashes at -O3 on a reduced C testcase with an assertion in ScalarEvolution::ExitLimit: no point in having a non-constant max backedge taken count. The crash occurs while the optimizer runs loop-rotate and loop-deletion, so ScalarEvolution, loop analysis, and loop transforms are the primary risk areas.

pr192829.title: clang-tidy crash in readability-container-size-empty
pr192829.bug_report_summary: clang-tidy crashes when running readability-container-size-empty on code that explicitly calls std::string's pseudo-destructor. The assertion says NamedDecl::getName requires a simple identifier, and the stack is inside AST matchers and clang-tidy's readability check.

pr120802.title: Clang crash on consteval lambda decltype instantiation
pr120802.bug_report_summary: Clang crashes compiling a C++20 consteval template that returns a lambda with decltype over another lambda call. The stack reaches ASTContext::getTypeInfo and Sema return-type deduction during template instantiation, so Sema, AST layout/type information, and lambda instantiation are the main risk areas.

pr199162.title: OpenACC reduction assertion Ty->isScalarType
pr199162.bug_report_summary: Clang crashes/asserts for an OpenACC reduction over a variable-length array. The target assertion is Ty->isScalarType in OpenACC semantic analysis while generating reduction initialization recipe expressions, so commits touching SemaOpenACC, OpenACC reduction checking, expression/type classification, or clang frontend semantic diagnostics are high risk.

pr173943.title: Clang crash with explicit object parameter call in C++03 mode
pr173943.bug_report_summary: Clang crashes while compiling a reduced C++ explicit-object-parameter testcase under -std=c++03. The target crash signal includes CheckArityMismatch and TooManyArguments while parsing or semantically diagnosing an invalid call expression, so commits touching Sema overload/call checking, parser handling for explicit object parameters, and C++ deducing-this support are high risk.

pr200987.title: Clang optimizer crash in SCEVExpander for asm goto loop
pr200987.bug_report_summary: Clang crashes at -O1 on a reduced C testcase using asm goto outputs and a pointer loop. The target crash signal includes isKnownSentinel, SCEVExpander, and rewriteLoopExitValues, so commits touching ScalarEvolution, loop exit rewriting, asm-goto codegen semantics, and optimizer loop canonicalization are high risk.

pr199526.title: Clang Sema assertion for vectorcall destructor override
pr199526.good_ref: normalized merge-base good anchor for llvmorg-22.1.0 and fix-parent

The crash signal includes defaultedDestructorIsDeleted, a Sema property not yet computed, DeclCXX.h, and destructor override handling, so commits touching CXXRecordDecl, destructor deletion/defaulting, override checks, calling conventions, and Sema class semantics are high risk.

pr197067.title: Clang unreachable while mangling a deduction guide in C++20 concepts code
pr197067.bug_report_summary: Clang hits an unreachable while emitting LLVM IR for a reduced C++20 concepts testcase. skip-pr199918-riscv.title: RISCV CodeGen build failure after Zvzip interleave shuffle change
